mechanism: Tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI that may potentiate serotonergic effects and increase sympathomimetic sensitivity, while letrozole is metabolized by CYP3A4/2A6 with potential for minor pharmacokinetic interaction.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms and hypertensive crisis; use combination cautiously in postmenopausal women with depression; ensure adequate washout periods if switching between agents.
